Or: the player has to click the choice that is the target rotated by some angle, and the icon indicates the rotation? Hmm.

The BR quadrant is framed (active), and its icon shows the red pattern to be achieved: {NW,W,E,SW}. The tiles are currently all blue. So the task is: click the BR tiles at NW, W, E, SW (i.e., top-left, middle-left, middle-right, bottom-left) to turn them red!
Wait, but if I click a red tile in TL, nothing happens. But maybe clicking a blue tile in BR turns it red? I clicked a blue tile in TL (5,7) — nothing happened. But maybe only the BR (framed/active) quadrant responds to clicks!
This makes sense: the framed quadrant is the "active" board. Its icon shows the target red pattern. I need to click the blue tiles in the positions where the icon has W: NW (tile at rows 36-41, cols 36-41, center (38,38)), W (center (46,38)), E (center (46,54)), SW (center (54,38)).
Let me verify the BR tile coordinates: BR tiles are at (36,36),(36,44),(36,52),(44,36),(44,52),(52,36),(52,44),(52,52), each 6x6. Centers: (38,38),(38,46),(38,54),(46,38),(46,54),(54,38),(54,46),(54,54).
Icon W positions: NW=(0,0) → tile (36,36) center (38,38); W=(1,0) → tile (44,36) center (46,38); E=(1,2) → tile (44,52) center (46,54); SW=(2,0) → tile (52,36) center (54,38).
Let me click (38,38) and see if it turns red. If it works, click the other three as well.
